name: router-ref-infinite-loop-bug
hook: Next.js useRouter in useEffect deps can cause infinite loop
body: When using `useRouter()` from `next/navigation` inside a `useEffect` with `router` in the dependency array, the effect can fire unexpectedly or cause issues in Next.js 15 where router reference may change. Fix by using a `useRef` to hold the router and updating it via a separate effect, so the main effect only depends on the actual triggering values (e.g., debounced search term).
why: Without this fix, the Search component's debounce mechanism is disrupted because the effect keeps re-firing as router changes, preventing proper URL updates.
